'Open' pane: search field with blue search button and list of saved projects (avatar, name, timestamp)
Ribbon toolbar and home start page dimmed under a grey scrim (username top right, New Feature / News link lists)

evidence.note: Full-height panel from the left edge over the app, with the rest dimmed by a grey scrim; back-arrow closes it, FILE ribbon tab opens it (checked live)

Vertical backstage items swap the panel content (New shows a 'New Project' form, Open shows project list — checked live). Ribbon tabs FILE/HOME/EDIT/ACCOUNT are also present but hidden under the panel in the capture

patterns.rationale: A flat list of saved projects with name and date plus search, like Office's Open backstage; no folders, path or preview, so it may be just a simple list rather than a file manager.

evidence.note: Saved project list, each with avatar, name and last-modified timestamp
Office-style ribbon top bar (tabs FILE/HOME/EDIT/ACCOUNT, grouped ribbon buttons, user identity) dimmed behind the backstage
Overlay is an edge-anchored full-height panel, coded as a drawer instead

structure.layout: Office-style backstage overlay: narrow blue left rail + light grey content pane over a scrim-dimmed ribbon application

aesthetics.typography: Chinese Quote (Ant Design system stack) for UI and links; Segoe UI for headings ('Open' 24px/500, project names 14px/500, start page heading 30px)
aesthetics.typeScale: Small range: 24px pane title, 14px item names and nav, 14px grey timestamps, 11px ribbon labels; weight contrast mainly 500 vs 300/400

notes: Copies the Microsoft Office 'File' backstage: a #2b569a blue rail with a circled back-arrow and plain white text items, next to a #f1f1f1 pane titled 'Open'. The pane has an Ant Design search input (4px radius, #1890ff button) and a thin-bordered list of projects. Each project has the same cartoon-robot avatar, a name, and a grey timestamp, separated by hairline dividers. Behind the panel, the ribbon and the start page (link lists in #1890ff) are dimmed by a translucent black scrim. Not coded: a 'New Project' form (Title, Description, Create) that only shows after clicking New.
